extracted.name: Garlic yogurt
extracted.description: Serve this cooling sauce with your favourite barbecued meats and flatbreads at summertime. It's a simple blend of natural yogurt, garlic and mint
instruction_lines: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl, season with salt and black pepper, and chill until needed. Will keep chilled for up to three days.
